description: Renovate config for the homelab GitOps repo. Replaces the onboarding default from the Renovate App.
Scheduling: Renovate rejects the later.js phrase 'before 6am on the first Sunday of the month' (validated:
`Invalid schedule: Failed to parse`), so the equivalent cron form is used: `* 0-5 * * 0#1` = every minute of
hours 00:00-05:59 local time on the first Sunday of the month (croner supports the `#` nth-weekday field;
verified next runs land on 2026-10-04 00:00-05:59 Europe/Berlin). Renovate's cron matcher only needs the
next run to fall in the current hour/day/month, so the window is deliberately 6h wide to guarantee the
monthly run is caught even if the Renovate App checks in late.
Pinning: `:pinDigests` adds digests to tags; the top-level `digest` block keeps digest-only updates enabled so
pinned refs are still bumped (must not fight the repo's digest-pinning convention).
No auto-merge anywhere: humans review every PR. Major updates stay ungrouped (all groups are restricted to
minor/patch), so each major gets its own PR.
Rule order matters: Renovate merges matching packageRules in order and the later rule's `groupName` wins, so
broad groups (container-images/github-actions) come first and the more specific ecosystem groups

packageRules.description: All container images not claimed by a more specific rule below (docker datasource only).

description: Talos ecosystem: Sidero Labs GitHub releases (talos, talos-backup, extensions), `ghcr.io/siderolabs/*`
images (installer, kubelet, talos-backup) and the siderolabs terraform provider/module datasources.
Kubernetes core: kubernetes/kubernetes releases, k8s.io/* Go modules and registry.k8s.io/* images.

packageRules.description: Flux ecosystem packages (flux2 CLI/releases, fluxcd/* controller images).
Flux manifest field updates (flux manager: HelmRelease/OCIRepository/GitRepository refs).

description: Helm charts resolved through a chart repository (bjw-s app-template, crowdsecurity, ...). Kept after the
flux rule so HelmRelease chart bumps read as chart updates rather than flux field updates.
